info.title: MajorPilot P7 operations, metrics and privacy API
info.description: Private local product operations and metrics-v2. Test/Bot/deletion exclusions, source-anchored cohorts, permissioned sensitive access, bounded private exports and account deletion receipts. This contract is not proof of live enforcement, human content review, production readiness or deployment.
